handoff.title: Switch to another agent
handoff.explain: Switch agents right here — no new chat is opened. A {from} session can't move to another CLI directly, so the new agent starts its own session and (if you keep the context) gets a brief: the original request, task list, files changed and the recent conversation.
handoff.notePlaceholder: e.g. Finish the tests and fix the remaining build error
handoff.foot: The new agent reads the brief and summarises where things stand before continuing
handoff.noAgents: No agent is installed on this machine
handoff.buttonTip: Switch this chat's agent (Claude ↔ Antigravity ↔ Codex ↔ Gemini) or clear its context — the chat stays the same
handoff.busy: The agent is running — stop it or wait before switching
handoff.keepTip: Send the new agent a brief of this chat
handoff.clearTip: The agent starts clean, knowing nothing from before — still in this chat
handoff.notePlaceholderClear: Leave empty to just clear the context without sending anything
handoff.footClear: The history stays visible in the chat, but the agent won't see it
handoff.doneClear: Context cleared — {agent} starts a new session in this chat
